data: In fiscal 2024, the year ended January 28, 2024, NVIDIA reported revenue of about $60.9 billion ($60,922 million), up 126% from $27.0 billion in fiscal 2023. Gross profit was about $44.3 billion ($44,301 million), a GAAP gross margin of roughly 72.7%, compared with 56.9% in fiscal 2023. Operating income was about $33.0 billion ($32,972 million), a GAAP operating margin of roughly 54.1%, up from about 15.7% the year before. The jump came mainly from Data Center sales of H100-based AI accelerators. These are GAAP figures from NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 Form 10-K. On a non-GAAP basis, which excludes items such as stock-based compensation, gross margin was about 73.8% and operating margin was higher than the GAAP figure.
